use: Cyclic voltammetry, constant-current electrolysis and other electrochemical measurements.
simulation: Reversible couples give peak currents by Randles–Ševčík; electrolysis deposits by Faraday's law.
notes: Reference model profile: potentiostat/galvanostat (used for constant-current electrolysis)
Spec values not individually verified (verified = false). The cell-voltage model is an assumption.
sources: Metrohm Autolab PGSTAT204 datasheet (to be archived and checked)

start.description: Start electrolysis (electrodes must first be inserted into the cell with attach_probe: device=pstat_1, port=cell)

run_cv.description: Cyclic voltammetry (cell port connected to the cell, three electrodes: 3 mm glassy carbon working electrode, Ag/AgCl reference): sweep from start to vertex and back. Result cv = {scan_rate_mV_s, peaks:[{Epc_V, Epa_V, ipc_uA, ipa_uA}]} (potentials vs Ag/AgCl)
